scope: Read-only preservation and shared-call-path review of the late MotoGP R3.1/R4 runtime integration through d4dd3e5 against the exact source inventory used by the completed motocross production journey. The update changes the shared motorcycle material pool and the crowd colour shader used by Valley grandstands and the initial road-venue menu. It is not described as GP-only isolation. Existing focused reports are referenced separately. No main45 captures, race gates, browser tests or GPU frames were rerun or relabeled by this review.

callPathAndOwnershipFindings.finding: BikeShells.build() selects DirtBikeModel for every definition with bike.offroad. MX250, MX450 and SM450 therefore use their own motocross chain, rotor, brake geometry and mud materials; GP chain/louver/radial-caliper constructors are not entered.

The GP geometry modules define constructors/functions at import; their visible meshes are allocated only when GP model branches call them. BikeMaterials itself now adds normal/roughness paint maps to paint, secondary and accent. Every MX material pool therefore allocates these six data maps. DirtBikeModel and its rider reference none of those three paint materials and continue constructing their separate polypropylene/plastic/board materials. MX42 can cover the shared allocation/import/disposal path, while GP41 is the actual rendered paint-map coverage. The BikeShells declaration is byte-identical to the captured build.

The new GP caliper merges and disposes intermediate geometries, borrows entrant-owned materials and is covered by the unchanged BikeModel.dispose traversal. Chain instance buffers use the existing InstancedMesh disposal branch. DirtBikeModel and its disposal/mud paths are whole-file unchanged.

createEntrant and Festival dirt-bike spawning choose DirtBikeVehicle for bike.offroad definitions. DirtBikeVehicle overrides step(), calling the dynamics core directly without super.step(). The incoming brake fade lives in BikeVehicle.step() behind explicit gpr1/gpr2 checks and is not applied to actual MX250/MX450/SM450 steps.

The new pixel-filtered warp/weft microrelief modifies installCrowdShader colour shading for mesh crowd LODs. Its condition gates the pixel footprint, sk < 0.01 and the shoe mask; it does not exclude accessory tags, so close non-skinned phone/cup shells may also receive relief and the 0.42 roughness floor. This is not described as clothing-only. Production Valley generic grandstands build CrowdClusters and receive the shader change, as does the initial road-venue menu. Arena SX skips generic grandstands and uses its independent Stadium clothing/skin materials. The unchanged world43 fixture contains OffroadScene, not Valley generic stands, so it does not compile this changed shader. The existing Phase27C crowd component exercises the same production colour/depth crowd shaders, near/mid/far handoffs, held/rewound pixels and memory; it is not a full MX venue capture.

All motocross terrain/scanned-soil, course dressing, stadium, replay-camera placement, chase/onboard, menu/HUD, snapshot, AI and offroad race-control files are among the 661 original sources whose complete bytes are unchanged. This whole-file preservation does not imply the shared crowd or material pool are unchanged.

retainedProductionBindingProbe.scope: Production createEntrant, adapter step and actual dynamics front/rear brake forces; no private solver or brake argument interception.
retainedProductionBindingProbe.fixture: Fresh independent physical states at 45 m, speed 28 m/s, Raw assists, front input 0.1 and rear input 0.1, one 1/240 s production step. Disc temperature is the only changed state between variants.
retainedProductionBindingProbe.result: At unsaturated front/rear input 0.1, each hot GP axle produces 0.78 times its cold force independently. SBK1000 and all three dirt adapters produce identical front/rear forces and resulting speed across all six temperature variants.
retainedProductionBindingProbe.limits: Assigned disc temperatures form controlled independent physical states, not a natural heat-up/cool-down experiment. These states are separate from the twenty focused assertions and the historical full race gate.

reproduction.method: Hash every file under final src/, keyed by its repository-relative POSIX path. Verify the final source-map identity. Remove the three added paths and replace the six modified path hashes with gameplaySourceSha256 from changes. The reconstructed 667-entry map must hash to the original gameplay source identity. Compare JSON with sorted keys, compact comma/colon separators and UTF-8 encoding.
